title: 30A Beach House Seacrest Serenity Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A pet friendly beach house rental with private heated pool, Seacrest Serenity, located in Inlet Beach, FL is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Pet Friendly with Private Pool
description_expanded: Description Description 30A pet friendly beach house rental with private heated pool, Seacrest Serenity, located in Inlet Beach, FL is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Pet Friendly with Private Pool Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 30A Beach House - Pet Friendly* .25 Miles from Beach* Spacious Backyard with Pool* Fenced Backyard - Perfect for Your Furry Friends* Covered Patio with Seating* Spacious Living Area with View of Private Pool* Large Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - King Bed (Main Level) - En Suite Bathroom w/Marble Shower* Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed (Main Level)* Bedroom 3 - King Bed Bed* Bathroom 4 - King Bed* Bedroom 5 - King Bed* Bunk Room w/Bunk Bed (T/T) & Daybed w/Twin Trundle* Flex Living Space - Main Level * Washer / Dryer * TVs are streaming service only* 6 Seater Golf Cart* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Sleeps 14 Pool may be heated for an additional charge of $50.00 per day. 30A Beach Access Points Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONSWe welcome 1 well trained dog under 40 lbs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. ADDITIONAL PET FEE APPLIES & IS COLLECTED AFTER BOOKING IS MADE. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
Pool / Spa / Hot Tub: Private Pool - Heated for an Additional Fee
